skills.summary: Design a pivot table that answers a question
skills.job: Choose rows, columns, values and filters for a pivot from the question asked, and prep the source data.
triggers: build a pivot table of sales by region
summarise this data by month and category
my pivot shows wrong totals
gotchas: source data with blank rows or merged headers
counts shown where sums were wanted
stale pivot after the data changed

skills.summary: Pick and write the right lookup formula
skills.job: Choose between XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH and VLOOKUP, and write a lookup that handles misses and duplicates.
triggers: pull the price from another sheet
vlookup returns N/A
match two lists and bring over a column
gotchas: duplicate keys return the first hit only

skills.summary: Build a one-page dashboard in a workbook

triggers: make a dashboard in excel
one page summary of this data
KPI sheet with charts

skills.summary: Add input rules and dropdowns to cells

triggers: add a dropdown to this column
stop people typing bad dates
restrict entries to a list
gotchas: list source not growing with new items

skills.summary: Highlight cells with rules that stay correct

triggers: highlight overdue rows

track spending against a plan

summary counts that miss new rows
